question: How many countries were ranked in the World Press Freedom Index 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**180**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **World Press Freedom Index** is an annual ranking published by **Reporters Without Borders (RSF)**, an international organization that evaluates press freedom worldwide.
 
• The index ranks a total of **180 countries and territories** based on the level of freedom available to journalists in each region.
 
• The ranking is determined by assessing factors such as **media independence**, **self-censorship**, **legal frameworks**, and the safety of journalists.
 
• The World Press Freedom Index is a **globally recognized tool** used by governments, organizations, and individuals to understand the state of press freedom across different countries.
 
• Option 1, **180**, is correct as the index consistently includes **180 countries** in its rankings.
